raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly recorded the Battle of Guam as occurring in 1945 (instead of 1944) and consequently concluded that the Battle of Manila (Feb 3–Mar 3, 1945) occurred first. This misdating led to the wrong chronological conclusion; correct dates show Guam (July 21–Aug 10, 1944) occurred before Manila.
